简体中文: 锻炼肉体和头脑的地方...啊？

简体中文: 可以让你从更多地方出发。

English: The cover is blocked by something.
简体中文: 下水井盖似乎被压住了。

简体中文: 快天黑了，蜘蛛出来觅食了。

English: If you're bleeding, use a bandage to stop it.
简体中文: 出血了的话，可以使用止血绷带止血。

English: It might be better to sell supplies that you often encounter.
简体中文: 经常能遇到的物资，不如把它卖了。

English: If a gun's durability go under 80%, it's damage and scatter performance are going to be affected.
简体中文: 枪械耐久低于80%，伤害和散布都会受到影响。

English: Pain will appear when being hit, it drains stamina and slower's your movement. Painkillers like Aspirin can counteract this effect.
简体中文: 被命中时会产生疼痛效果，消耗耐力并短暂减速。止痛药可以抵消这个影响。

English: Press T to change bullet type when holding a gun.
简体中文: 持枪时，按T键，可以更换子弹类型。

English: In inventory interface, drag and drop parts to weapons to quickly install them. But make sure it matches.
简体中文: 在背包界面，将配件拖到武器上即可快速安装，不过要注意是否匹配。

English: When a melee enemy flashes red, it's the time to dodge-roll.
简体中文: 近战敌人闪红光时，就是你翻滚的时机。

English: When holding weapon, your movement speed will be affected.
简体中文: 手持武器时，你的移动速度会受到影响。

English: The enemy's threat is greatly reduced, and your efficiency has improved. However, caution is still necessary.
简体中文: 不能说完全没有难度，敌人的威胁大幅降低，并提高你的输出。但你依然要保持谨慎。

English: Enhances stamina and stamina recovery, but consumes more water for 180 seconds.
简体中文: 增强耐力和耐力回复，但消耗更多水分，持续180秒。

English: Connect to the black market contact point and conduct some transactions with floating prices.
简体中文: 连接黑市网络，进行一些有价格浮动的交易。

English: You look like... a good Joe." Balanced experience."
简体中文: 特点是没有特点，非常均衡。

English: The body is strong and can handle a lot of damage. But the legs are not good just like brain.
简体中文: 身体强健，抗揍，但腿跟脑子一样不太好使。

English: Although look skinny, porters are very capable in carrying things.
简体中文: 看似瘦弱，但扛起东西来毫不逊色。

English: I must use melee weapons. Guns? I don't know that stuff very well. (According to a Berserker)
简体中文: 那肯定得用近战武器，枪是什么？不太会用。

English: Marksmen love shooting guns, from a distance.
简体中文: 爱打枪，打枪就远远的打。

English: Items lost upon death are irretrievable, leaving nothing to reclaim. Enemies are deadlier than ever, inflicting 1.5x their usual damage.
简体中文: 敌人造成1.5倍伤害！不会生成遗失物。
